payload.summary: Implemented all five phases: the Postgres analyzer skips inapplicable input, optional grammars resolve per analyzer stage, run_architecture.py gains --ensure, SQLAlchemy metadata becomes an optional SQL schema source, the gate reports architecture without blocking on it, and six consumer skills ensure freshness at their read boundary. The plan predated fix-architecture-freshness-evidence, so its committed-baseline requirement was rewritten in that change's tier vocabulary rather than dropping the clean-checkout freshness promise.
completed_work: Phase 1: postgres analyzer skips inapplicable input; per-grammar optional-tool resolution; PRODUCER_VERSION 1.4.0
Phase 2: run_architecture.py --ensure, composing --check and --staged with no third path
Phase 3: dump_sqlalchemy_schema.py and SCHEMA_SOURCE=sqlalchemy; task 3.4 verified the HEAD guard cannot trip
Phase 4: the gate routes architecture to informational_drift; exactly one exit code moves, in one direction
Phase 5: six consumer skills ensure at their read boundary; checkpoint.py pinned never to ensure
Spec: the committed-baseline requirement rewritten tier-aware, with two new scenarios

decisions.title: The architecture baseline requirement is tier-aware, not tier-blind
decisions.rationale: D2 was authored before fix-architecture-freshness-evidence landed a per-artifact tier, so it rejected Approach C on a behaviour that no longer exists -- an absent local-cache artifact is not stale and not missing, it is not drift -- and asserted that no consumer commits the artifacts, which is false for this repository. The requirement now says provenance shares the version-control status of its committed-tier artifacts: an all-committed repository keeps the clean-checkout guarantee its CI demonstrated, while a local-cache consumer gets the unverified-until-ensure posture. No new mechanism was needed.

decisions.title: Architecture is reclassified through an existing keyword, not a new branch
decisions.rationale: classify_degradation already accepts informational_producer_ids, which gate.py was defaulting. Passing a frozenset at the call site leaves the pure classifier and its structural purity pins untouched, and leaves the orchestrator's default describing only openspec.projection for every other caller.

decisions.title: Consumers ensure at the skill's documented read step, never inside the scripts
decisions.rationale: validate_flows.py, analyze_coupling.py and validate_schema.py all take an explicit artifact path and are run against fixtures with no repository. A script that regenerated would regenerate against cwd while reading a caller-supplied tmpdir, break hermetic tests, and impose on a caller-supplied path exactly the posture change D8 refuses for the checkpoint.

decisions.title: A failed --ensure degrades loudly rather than stopping the consumer
decisions.rationale: A failed staged run preserves last known-good, so the reader has degraded input rather than none. All six consumers are advisory analysis producers that already degraded on missing artifacts. Hard-failing would reintroduce on the reader's side the blocking consequence D3 just removed from the gate, locking out any machine that cannot run the pipeline.

decisions.title: PRODUCER_VERSION skipped 1.3.0 deliberately
decisions.rationale: 1.3.0 belongs to the per-artifact tier change on main. Reusing it for per-grammar tool identity would have given one version string two meanings once the histories met -- which they did, during the rebase, where it resolved cleanly to 1.4.0.

next_steps: Validate: run the gate and the consumer skills on a clean clone, where the PRODUCER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH regeneration will fire once.
Validate: confirm the six call sites behave under an installed skill payload, not only in this checkout.
Follow-up: reconcile the three stale prose sites that still say unverifiable provenance blocks.
